title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center Arena on 1973-03-28
lineage: Dat -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a 1973 second‑set with an epic WR Prelude → Dark Star run and tight band interplay.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the extraordinary mid‑section—WR Prelude into Dark Star (and the ensuing Eyes/Daybreak) — calling it “exquisite” and one of the most impressive stretches they’ve heard. The soundboard source is praised for crystal‑clear fidelity, and the band’s second‑set flow, vocal harmonies and Jerry’s guitar work are highlighted throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: All detailed reviews praise both performance and sound quality; no negative comments were found, indicating an outstanding show captured on a high‑grade soundboard.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the audio as “exquisite” with no noted dropouts or muddiness; the file name confirms a soundboard (sbd) source.

standout_songs: Weather Report Suite Prelude → Dark Star → Eyes → Daybreak
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second‑set opener and transitions are repeatedly praised; reviewers note the set moves smoothly from high‑energy rockers to reflective ballads, creating a dynamic arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Highlighted for strong backing vocals (e.g., on ‘Loose Lucy’) and his signature guitar tone during the long Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Bob: Praised for nailing ‘Me & My Uncle’ and making it his own, especially as a first‑set closer in earlier eras.
